title: Principal Engineer-Verification
jobDescription: Role Overview You will be responsible for verifying DDR4/5 memory controllers and AXI input interfaces for IP-level designs, ensuring full protocol compliance, error handling, data integrity and performance computation for high-speed DDR interfaces. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain System Verilog UVM-based verification environments for DDR4/DDR5 memory controller and PHY IP. Define verification plans, design testbenches, and create directed and constrained-random testcases. Write and debug testcases and sequences for DDR protocol features (read/write operations, refresh, training, power-down modes). Validate ECC, parity, and command/address/data integrity mechanisms. Develop and debug scoreboards, assertions (SVA), and checkers for data integrity and protocol correctness. Integrate AXI, APB VIPs with DDR subsystem. Perform coverage analysis (code, functional, assertion) to ensure verification completeness. Debug RTL and simulation failures using waveform analysis (Sim Vision, Verdi). Work with design teams to debug RTL and root-cause functional/timing issues in RTL and GLS. Collaborate with post-silicon and firmware teams for memory bring-up and validation. Mentor verification engineers and drive best practices Technical Skills Strong knowledge of DDR protocol (JEDEC specifications). Experience with System Verilog, UVM, and verification methodology. Hands-on with simulation tools like Synopsys VCS, Cadence Xcelium, or Mentor Questa. Good understanding of memory controller architecture and timing parameters (setup/hold, t RCD, t RP, etc.). Knowledge of AXI protocol and its integration with DDR controller. Familiarity with assertions (SVA), scoreboarding, and functional coverage. Familiarity with GLS is a plus. Drive debug efficiency improvements by leveraging modern methodologies, script automation (Python), and integrating AI/LLM-assisted workflows to accelerate root-cause analysis and triage. Soft Skills Strong analytical and debugging skills. Able to deliver tasks independently. Good communication and leadership skills. Comfortable collaborating across design, validation, and firmware teams. Requirements/

title: Senior Engineer I - Physical Design
jobDescription:
Microchip’s DSPIC Business Unit is seeking a skilled and experienced Physical Design Engineer to join our global DSPIC Physical Design team. In this role, you will be instrumental in driving the successful execution of microcontrollers and microcontroller-based SOC designs, delivering the next generation of hierarchical, low power, mixed signal microcontroller solutions. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Implement complex mixed signal, low power designs using state-of-the-art FLASH process technologies. Work independently and efficiently on assigned project responsibilities, from new design exploration through delivery of GDS (netlist to GDSII flow) and Metal-only ECO implementation. Provide Physical Design support for test chip shuttles, including development work associated with new concepts and flow. Develop and enhance Physical Design flow and methodology, including comprehensive documentation. Conduct power integrity and reliability analysis, ensuring robust sign-off for all designs. Detailed Job function: Conduct floorplan exploration and optimization for accurate die size estimation. Perform power domain and voltage area-based floor planning, including power grid planning and implementation. Execute placement and optimization with a focus on timing, area, and power efficiency. Manage clock tree synthesis, balancing, and debugging to ensure robust clock distribution. Drive post-route timing optimization and timing closure to meet design specifications. Perform timing and signal integrity analysis at both chip and block levels. Ability to lead chip and block level physical implementation activities. Develop and refine physical design flow and methodology for improved efficiency and quality. Conduct physical verification, including DRC (Design Rule Check) and LVS (Layout Versus Schematic). Ensure IR drop and electromigration (EM) signoff for reliable power delivery. Implement timing and metal-only ECOs (Engineering Change Orders) as needed. Interface with internal and external IP teams, as well as CAD vendors, to resolve technical issues. Collaborate closely with synthesis, DFT, and other cross-functional global teams to achieve timely tapeout and ensure first-pass working silicon. Requirements/
minimumQualification: Bachelor of Engineering in Electrical / Electronic Engineering or Master of Engineering in Electrical / Electronic Engineering or Equivalent Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in Physical Design and related technical areas, demonstrating a strong track record of successful project execution. Advanced knowledge of place and route methodologies, as well as low power physical design flows and methodologies. Proficiency with industry-standard physical implementation and analysis tools such as Innovus or Fusion Compiler, Calibre, Redhawk, Starrcxt, or equivalent EDA tools. Strong scripting skills in TCL, PERL, and Shell, along with working knowledge of hardware description languages such as Verilog and VHDL. Excellent analytical and debugging abilities, with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving technical challenges. Independent, self-motivated, and capable of managing responsibilities. title: Sr. Manager - SOC Verification
jobDescription: As the So C Verification Manager, you will be a critical leader in our ds PIC Microcontroller Business Unit, responsible for ensuring the functional integrity of our next-generation 32-bit MCU products. You will lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing team of 20+ verification engineers to execute complex verification strategies for So Cs featuring ARM and specialized proprietary cores. Your mission is to drive "First-Pass Silicon Success" by bridging the gap between architectural intent and silicon implementation through cutting-edge UVM and Formal methodologies. Key Responsibilities Strategic Leadership: Own the end-to-end verification strategy, from initial test plan development to final tape-out sign-off for multiple concurrent MCU projects. Team Management: Lead and develop a global team of 20+ engineers. Manage resource allocation, performance reviews, and technical career growth. Architecture Oversight: Define and refine scalable, reusable testbench architectures that support both simulation-based (UVM) and formal-based verification flows. Technical Excellence: Drive the adoption of advanced techniques, including Formal Verification, Power-Aware Verification (UPF/CPF), and Hardware-Software Co-verification. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Architecture, RTL Design, Digital Signal Processing (DSP), and Physical Design teams to resolve complex integration issues and architectural bottlenecks. Methodology Innovation: Continuously improve verification efficiency through automation, Python/Perl scripting, and the integration of AI-driven verification tools. Requirements/
minimumQualification: Education: Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering or Computer Science, with strong digital design fundamentals. Experience: 12+ years in SoC Verification, with at least 5 years in a formal leadership or management role. Domain Expertise: Proven track record of successful tape-outs for 32-bit Microcontrollers. Deep understanding of MCU peripherals (DMA, Timers, ADC/DAC interfaces, Security modules). Processor Knowledge: Direct experience verifying SoCs with ARM cores (Cortex-M) and proprietary RISC-based architectures. Methodologies: Expert-level command of SystemVerilog and UVM (Universal Verification Methodology). Strong hands-on experience with Formal Verification (Property Checking, Connectivity Checking) using tools like JasperGold or VC Formal. title: Senior Engineer (Software Testing)
jobDescription: We are looking for an energetic and self-motivated person with the Computer Science background to join our Firmware / Embedded Software team in the Communication Business Unit at Microchip. We are building firmware for high performance System on Chip (So C) and Ethernet PHY devices developed by our hardware teams. These products include the PIC64-HPSC product (https://www.microchip.com/en-us/products/microprocessors/64-bit-mpus/pic64-hpsc), which is radiation-hardened multi-core RISC-V processor, intended for spaceflight computing and the Meta-DX2 product, an 800 Gb E Ethernet PHY/retimer device for data center, enterprise, service provider, and AI/ML networking applications. These devices support the aerospace and communications markets as well as a growing number of applications in next generation embedded systems. Our focus is on technical excellence, teamwork, collaboration, and continuous improvements in an open and encouraging environment. If you have a strong technical background in firmware or embedded software testing, embedded systems, and communications protocols, then this is the position for you! As a Senior Firmware Verification Engineer, you will be part of a team of professionals designing and implementing tests for embedded software and drivers for modern System-on-Chip (So C) devices. You will participate in all stages of the firmware / embedded software project, for example: defining functional test plans, building/supporting test frameworks, automated regression environment and test infrastructure, designing and implementing tests and working with the Software Development teams to resolve bugs. This verification work spans the pre-silicon development phase, which uses FPGA-based prototyping platforms and the post-silicon phase which uses lab-based evaluation boards. Additionally, our team leverages AI tools such as Claude Code and Git Hub Co Pilot in all areas of software test development. RESPONSIBILITIES Translate functional specifications, requirements, and standards into comprehensive test plans Design, develop, and debug tests to verify firmware / embedded software and maintain these tests in regression Developing and supporting our CI/CD automated regression environment Developing and maintaining test frameworks for both pre and post silicon testing Leverage AI tools such as Claude Code or Git Hub Co Pilot in all areas of software test development Setup and configuration of 3rd party test equipment and Microchip So C test boards Writing and reviewing comprehensive engineering documentation Work with the product development, application, and validation engineering teams as part of test related activities Requirements/

title: Senior Validation Engineer II
jobDescription: JOB DESCRIPTION * We are seeking a Senior Validation Engineer-2 for Microchip’s MCU division to support validation and characterization of 8-bit and 32-bit microcontrollers. Microchip is a world leader in 8, 16, and 32- bit microcontrollers. The Validation Engineering position is focused on helping with development of our digital and parametric testing infrastructure. Significant time will be spent developing test cases, performing lab bench experiments, and assisting other team members in the validation of 8 and 32-bit microcontrollers at the unit and system-level. This position is based in Bangalore, India. As a validation engineer, you will work with worldwide teams located in France, USA, Philippines, India and other corporate team members. JOB REQUIREMENTS Develop and implement functional, performance and system level/use-case validation of 8 and 32 bit microcontrollers Experience with Microcontrollers, FPGAs, and in general, Embedded Systems. Familiar with embedded ARM Cortex M family, RISC-V, MIPS is preferred Experience with communication busses (GPIB, RS-232, RS-485, SPI/QSPI, I2C, I2S, USB, EBI, Ethernet, etc.). Experience with Embedded firmware development and should have strong hands-on knowledge of embedded C programming language Candidate will have the primary role of creating, auditing, and overseeing test procedures, validation plans, data collection, post-processing of validation data, reports, and documenting results. jobDescription: Role Summary The Digital Verification Engineer will be a key driver in the development and implementation of advanced verification methodologies for our digital-based products. This position gives you an opportunity to work on various embedded software systems for safety critical applications as well as the systems targeted towards Io T, consumer and industrial applications. Resolve customer issues in the software delivered and in-turn provide feedback and new ideas for the ecosystem enhancement. Work with global teams across timezones on cross functional tasks Take part in documentation, code reviews and specification reviews. Requirements/

Our product portfolio comprises general purpose and specialized 8-bit, 16-bit, and 32-bit microcontrollers, 32-bit microprocessors, field-programmable gate array (FPGA) products, a broad spectrum of high-performance linear, mixed-signal, power management, thermal management, radio frequency (RF), timing, safety, security, wired connectivity and wireless connectivity devices, as well as serial Electrically Erasable Programmable Read Only Memory (EEPROM), Serial Flash memories, Parallel Flash memories, and serial Static Random Access Memory (SRAM). title: Principal Engineer - FPGA Video Solutions
jobDescription:
About the Company Microchip Technology Inc. is a leading provider of embedded control applications. Our product portfolio comprises general purpose and specialized 8-bit, 16-bit, and 32-bit microcontrollers, 32-bit microprocessors, field-programmable gate array (FPGA) products, a broad spectrum of high-performance linear, mixed-signal, power management, thermal management, radio frequency (RF), timing, safety, security, wired connectivity, and wireless connectivity devices, as well as serial Electrically Erasable Programmable Read Only Memory (EEPROM), Serial Flash memories, Parallel Flash memories, and serial Static Random Access Memory (SRAM). We also license Flash-IP solutions incorporated in a broad range of products. About the team Microchip FPGA Business unit offers FPGA device families suited for secure, power-efficient compute in a wide range of applications within Imaging, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning (AI/ML), Internet of Things (Io T), Industrial Automation, Automotive, Aerospace and Defense, Wireline Access Networks & Cellular Infrastructure. The Smart Embedded Vision team builds the next generation 8K video and image processing solutions for Microchip FPGA products using the latest technology trends. The team develops video solutions for high-speed camera protocols, display protocols, and video compression based on MJPEG and H.264. The video solution development includes defining the architecture of the IPs based on standard specs, writing the RTL code, verifying in simulation, and validating the hardware. The video interface IPs and advanced image processing IPs together create a complete solution. The Smart Embedded Vision team also defines the features and specifications of the evaluation boards for vision applications. About the Position This position is an excellent opportunity for someone willing to work on the latest technologies and play a critical role in providing a roadmap for video solutions. The individual will work on developing RTL designs, video and image processing algorithms, video interface protocols, and computer vision applications for the Microchip FPGA products. The individual must have strong RTL (VHDL/Verilog) coding skills and digital design concepts. In addition, the individual must be able to work in a fast-paced, high-demand, multiple-deadline driven environment. Job

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop Video and Image processing IPs and integrate into complete video solution Develop IPs for video interface protocols such as HDMI, MIPI, SDI, etc. Understand the standards and specs for video protocols Implement RTL design, coding and take it through industry standard design flows Develop the Test Bench architecture, test plan for functional verification of the IPs Run FPGA design flow, set timing constraints and fix timing issues Integrate the developed IPs into the overall system design and validate on the Smart Embedded Vision hardware kits Debug the system on the hardware using Microchip debugging tools and testing equipment Adhere to quality standards from RTL coding to complete validation of the system Requirements/

title: Technical Staff Engineer - Emulation
jobDescription: The FPGA Emulation team in the MCU division is looking for a pre-silicon FPGA validation engineer. As an experienced validation engineer, you will interact with design engineers in charge of different parts of our microcontrollers, define test plans and implement tests. Having good debugging and investigation skills is crucial in this role. You will also need to have a system approach and therefore consider the microcontroller as a whole rather than the sum of its constituents. title: Principal Engineer - Applications
jobDescription:
Microchip is seeking a Principal Applications Engineer
- Wireless Systems to provide advanced technical leadership, customer engagement, and application development support for embedded wireless controllers and So C products. This role requires deep expertise in embedded systems, wireless technologies, firmware development, customer-facing technical support, and cross-functional collaboration. The Principal Engineer will serve as a technical expert supporting global customers, influencing product direction, enabling design-ins and design-wins, and mentoring engineering teams. The role involves solving complex customer design challenges, developing high-quality reference solutions, and creating technical collateral that accelerates customer adoption of Microchip wireless products. Key Responsibilities Act as a technical expert for embedded wireless controllers, So Cs, software frameworks, SDKs, and wireless connectivity solutions. Provide advanced technical support to global customers, field application engineers, sales teams, and internal engineering teams for wireless embedded applications. Develop innovative and scalable solutions to address complex customer design challenges, system-level issues, and product integration problems. Lead the design, development, validation, and release of demo applications, reference designs, sample projects, and proof-of-concept solutions showcasing real-world use cases of Microchip wireless products. Drive customer design-ins and design-wins by executing reference designs, customer projects, application notes, and technical demonstrations. Collaborate closely with internal software, firmware, systems, silicon, validation, product marketing, and applications engineering teams to define, implement, optimize, and debug product features. Analyze customer requirements and provide architectural guidance for embedded wireless applications involving Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, IEEE 802.15.4, and other relevant wireless technologies. Validate, test, debug, and release SDKs, software framework packages, and application examples to ensure high quality, reliability, and ease of customer adoption. Lead complex system-level debugging efforts involving embedded firmware, wireless protocol stacks, hardware interfaces, RF behavior, RTOS, and application-layer software. Create high-quality technical resources such as Application notes, User guides, Training presentations, Instructional videos and Demo documentation Develop and deliver technical training for customers, distributors, field engineers, and internal teams. Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on embedded software development, wireless systems, debugging methodologies, customer communication, and applications engineering best practices. Provide feedback to product development teams based on customer use cases, competitive analysis, field issues, and market requirements. Work effectively in a global, cross-functional, and virtual team environment while independently managing multiple customer and internal priorities. Travel as required to visit customers, support technical workshops, assist with on-site debugging, deliver product training, participate in design reviews, and support strategic customer engagements. Use AI productivity tools such as Claude, Git Hub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, or similar platforms to improve efficiency in technical documentation, presentation creation, customer training material, and application note development. Leverage AI-assisted development tools where appropriate to support firmware development, code generation, code review, debugging, test creation, and productivity improvement while ensuring compliance with company security, quality, and IP protection guidelines. Requirements/
minimumQualification: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Communication Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Typically requires extensive experience in embedded systems, wireless applications, firmware development, customer support, or systems applications engineering. Strong hands-on experience in embedded software and firmware development, including bare-metal and framework-based development. Expert-level programming experience in C and C++ for embedded systems. Strong understanding of embedded software architecture, firmware design, driver development, debugging, and system optimization. Deep knowledge of wireless technologies and hands-on experience integrating, validating, and debugging wireless protocol stacks, including Wi-Fi, Bluetooth / BLE, IEEE 802.15.4 and Other low-power wireless connectivity technologies Strong knowledge of protocol stacks and the OSI networking model, particularly for wireless and embedded networking systems. Experience with RTOS and embedded operating environments such as: FreeRTOS, Zephyr, Linux-based embedded systems and Other real-time embedded frameworks Experience with 8-bit, 16-bit, and 32-bit microcontrollers and embedded peripherals, including: ADC, DAC, PWM, RTC, WDT, Timers/counters, GPIO, DMA and Interrupt controllers Strong knowledge of communication interfaces and peripheral protocols, including: I2C, SPI, UART, CAN and USB Strong ability to debug complex system-level embedded issues involving firmware, hardware, wireless connectivity, timing, memory, power, and peripheral interactions. Hands-on experience with lab and debugging tools (oscilloscopes, logic/protocol analyzers, RF equipment, debug probes, IDE tools) and good understanding of hardware design concepts such as schematic review, PCB layout, signal integrity, power design, and RF guidelines. Familiarity with Microchip microcontrollers, microprocessors, wireless solutions, touch technology, FPGA products, tools, and documentation is an added advantage. Excellent written and spoken English communication skills. Ability to support customers in designing, developing, integrating, validating, and troubleshooting embedded wireless applications, and to deliver practical, creative solutions for resolving design and implementation challenges. Collaborates effectively with customers, field teams, and internal engineering teams to resolve issues and meet design requirements. Influences technical direction, drives decisions, and provides leadership without direct authority. Strong customer-facing communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills. Self-driven, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities independently. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with effective project tracking and reporting. Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed to support customers, field teams, technical trainings, workshops, and strategic business opportunities. Preferred Skills Experience supporting global customers in a semiconductor, embedded systems, or wireless connectivity environment. Experience developing production-quality firmware, SDK examples, reference applications, and customer-ready demos. Experience with wireless certification, interoperability testing, regulatory considerations, or RF validation. Experience with secure embedded systems, bootloaders, OTA firmware updates, low-power optimization, and cloud-connected embedded applications. Experience using AI-assisted tools such as Claude, GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar tools for engineering productivity, documentation, training content, and firmware development support. Ability to translate complex technical topics into clear customer-facing documentation, presentations, demonstrations, and training material. title: Design House & Partner Ecosystem Manager
jobDescription: Are you a self-starter? Do you think different? At Microchip Technology, our value system empowers our employees to develop and thrive in a supportive, collaborative, professional, global, and rewarding working environment. We embrace change and continuous improvement, driving both to the mutual benefit of ourselves and our clients. We are looking for like-minded people who can share our passion for success. As a Design House & Partner Ecosystem Manager, you will be responsible for building and leading Microchip’s partner program with India’s design house ecosystem. India has become one of the world’s most significant embedded design centres — a growing network of engineering firms across the country actively developing products and platforms for some of the largest OEMs and Fortune 500 companies worldwide, defining bills of materials and making silicon selection decisions that shape global products. You will be expected to ensure that Microchip’s semiconductor solutions are designed into these products at the earliest possible stage — building a partner ecosystem that creates a sustainable multiplier effect for Microchip’s business across worldwide markets. This is not a traditional sales role. It is a strategic program-building mandate that demands equal measures of technical depth, business development acumen, and ecosystem orchestration capability. India’s design houses design for the world. Your job is to make sure they design with Microchip. When an engineering firm in Bangalore is designing an industrial controller for a European automation company, or a team in Pune is developing a motor drive platform for a North American OEM, or a design house is architecting a communications or power management solution for a global defense program — those are the moments that matter. This role exists to make Microchip the semiconductor partner of choice at exactly these inflection points. Job Responsibilities Program Strategy & Governance Develop and own Microchip’s India Design House & Partner Program — defining the engagement model, partner selection criteria, co-investment framework, and governance structure — and build a multi-year partner ecosystem strategy aligned to Microchip’s India and global growth objectives. Map India’s design house ecosystem against Microchip’s product and technology portfolio, identifying where the greatest strategic leverage exists across verticals, geographies, and product families — and prioritise program investment accordingly. Establish a differentiated partner enablement framework encompassing access to reference designs, evaluation hardware, FAE support, technical training, and co-development opportunities, calibrated to the strategic importance of each partner relationship. Define, track, and communicate program-level metrics — including influenced pipeline, design win activity, and partner engagement depth — providing regular reporting to Microchip sales leadership and relevant business units. Partner Recruitment & Relationship Development Identify, recruit, and onboard new design house and engineering services partners across India’s major design centres, targeting firms active in industrial automation, defense and aerospace, drone and UAV systems, automotive, power electronics, medical devices, and communications verticals. Build and sustain multi-level relationships within partner organisations — from engineering leads and solution architects to business development teams and senior leadership — positioning Microchip as a strategic technology collaborator rather than a transactional component supplier. Develop joint partner business plans with key partners, establishing shared objectives, co-investment commitments, and mutual accountability for design win outcomes. Maintain and deepen existing design house relationships, increasing Microchip’s breadth of product family representation and engineering mindshare across the partner base. Technology Seeding & Design Influence Serve as the primary technical interface between Microchip and its design house partners, driving Microchip silicon selection into designs at the architecture and component selection stage for products destined for worldwide OEM and Fortune 500 programs — ahead of competing technologies. Engage with partner engineering teams at a system architecture level, providing substantive technical guidance across Microchip’s MCU, DSC, FPGA, power management, security, connectivity, and timing product portfolio as it applies to partners’ active design programs. Collaborate with Microchip’s FAE teams and business unit application engineers to co-develop partner-relevant reference designs, solution stacks, and technical enablement collateral aligned to the end markets and OEM programs in which design house partners are most active. Lead or co-deliver technical workshops, product roadmap briefings, and hands-on training programs tailored to design house engineering audiences, building sustained Microchip technology preference within partner organisations. Business Unit Collaboration & Market Intelligence Serve as the principal interface between India’s design house ecosystem and Microchip’s global business units — providing structured, actionable feedback on partner technology requirements, OEM program trends, competitive dynamics, and unaddressed product gaps. Collaborate actively with Microchip product managers and application teams to align product roadmaps, reference design priorities, and go-to-market initiatives with real-world intelligence gathered through partner engagement. Contribute and participate within a global team environment, coordinating with Microchip’s global key account management teams when India-based design firms are developing products for Microchip’s global strategic accounts or Fortune 500 customers. Communicate effectively with Microchip product divisions, providing quantifiable feedback and ROI reporting on partner program investment, design win activity, and influenced pipeline. Candidate must be able to independently develop and execute partner business development plans, assess strategic risks and commercial opportunities, take appropriately bold steps, and drive plans through to measurable outcomes. Requirements/
minimumQualification: Job requires extensive travelling within India across all major engineering and design hubs, and outside India for partner engagements, business unit collaboration, and industry events. Candidate must possess a valid passport. Job requires working with design houses and engineering services partners operating across India, and with the global OEM and Fortune 500 programs those partners serve. Candidate is expected to collaborate with Microchip global key account managers, business units, product managers, and other stakeholders in different geographies working on the same global accounts. Openness, sharing, and collaborating are the key virtues of the candidate. Candidate is expected to team up and collaborate with Microchip’s FAE teams, peer business development managers, distributors, and design partners to drive key programs and initiatives across the ecosystem. Openness, sharing, and collaborating with end results in mind are the key virtues of the candidate. Benefits Microchip’s non-commissioned total compensation and benefits package includes a competitive base salary, bonus aligned with company goals, employee stock purchase program, health insurance coverage, etc. Opportunity to build and own a high-visibility strategic partner program on an entrepreneurial and collaborative basis — with direct impact on Microchip’s market development in one of the world’s most consequential embedded design ecosystems — and to be compensated for success in driving the organisation’s growth. Access to Microchip’s global technical resources, product teams, and business unit networks, enabling the candidate to operate with the full backing of a leading global semiconductor company in building something genuinely new. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Electronics or EE or E&C Engineering discipline with a strong academic track record. A bachelor’s or postgraduate degree in business management would be desirable. Minimum of eight to twelve years’ relevant work experience, either in the semiconductor industry in applications engineering, field applications engineering, or technical business development — or directly within a design house, electronics system design and manufacturing (ESDM) firm, engineering research and development organisation, or electronic system integrator in India. Candidates who have built their experience within design houses or engineering services organisations are strongly encouraged to apply; first-hand knowledge of how these organisations evaluate semiconductor solutions, structure design programs, and make component selection decisions is highly relevant to this role. Demonstrated experience developing and managing partner, channel, or ecosystem programs — including the establishment of governance frameworks, joint business plans, and outcome-based metrics. Relationship management experience alone, without program structure and accountability, does not satisfy this requirement. Solid technical grounding in embedded system design with demonstrable competence across at least two of the following domains: microcontroller and DSC-based system design; FPGA platforms; motor control and power electronics; embedded connectivity and communications; or industrial, defense, and aerospace electronics. The ability to engage credibly with design engineers at a system architecture level — earning technical trust through genuine depth — is essential. Competencies Strategic/Critical Thinking—Systematically evaluates the design house ecosystem as a system of leverage points; identifies where Microchip engagement creates compounding value; hypothesises partner needs, program gaps, and market opportunities; brainstorms with internal and external stakeholders to devise solutions to complex ecosystem challenges. Communication—Tailors communication to the audience with authority — credible and compelling in executive-level strategic conversations and equally effective in hands-on technical workshops with engineering teams; delivers presentations with conviction and has strong verbal and written communication skills. Technical Credibility—Brings sufficient depth in embedded system design to earn the trust and respect of experienced engineers; engages at a system architecture and component selection level; provides technically substantive guidance across Microchip’s product portfolio as it applies to partner programs and active design challenges. Interpersonal Influence—Uses rational and technical drivers that appeal to engineering and business stakeholders within partner organisations; builds consensus for Microchip’s solutions by demonstrating genuine value; comfortably drives conversations toward outcomes that are beneficial to both parties. Networking—Identifies the right stakeholders within design house and OEM partner organisations and builds trusted connections quickly to drive design-in momentum; works cooperatively with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders — FAE teams, global KAMs, BU product managers, and partner engineering and commercial leads — to achieve shared outcomes. Ownership—Goes beyond the assigned brief to ensure program outcomes are achieved; demonstrates relentless drive to deliver results; is independent, self-directed, and takes initiative; creates structure and accountability around complex and ambiguous mandates. Workflow Management—Sets clear, realistic, and time-bound objectives for partner program activities that align to Microchip’s business growth priorities; manages multiple concurrent partner engagements and internal initiatives with appropriate prioritisation and rigour. title: Senior Engineer I - Device Modelling
jobDescription: About the Company: Microchip FPGA Product Group is the leading supplier of nonvolatile, low-power programmable technologies. Our mission is to manage power consumption at both the chip and the system level, leveraging the industry's lowest power FPGAs and unique mixed-signal FPGAs to offer system designers a competitive edge. Our Design Center in Hyderabad, India is a growing and vital member of the group. About this Position: You will join the Device Data Modeling team. You will work closely with silicon design engineers, software engineers and technology development engineers to develop timing & power models for use in Microchip Libero software suite, simulation and synthesis. This can include the modeling of complex IPs integrated inside the fabric such as CPUs and various analog blocks. Good communication and presentation skills are required.
